info.name: Library Management API
info.description: Library Management API 1.0.0. Generated from openapi.json and checked against the Flask routes/services. Includes all 16 library operations and 2 documentation endpoints. Import Local.postman_environment.json and select Local. Recommended manual workflow: Members / Register a member -> Books / Add a book -> Loans / Check out a book -> Loans / Get a loan -> Loans / Renew a loan (optional, once before return) -> Members / Get member loans and balance -> Loans / Return a book -> Reports. Edit the registration email before repeating it. Pay a fine requires a returned loan with a positive unpaid fine; an on-time return has no fine. Example responses are illustrative snapshots, not assertions about your database. See postman/README.md. POST operations modify data; loan mutations append outbox.txt notifications. Delete a book is blocked unless allowDelete is explicitly set to true; never run the entire collection as automatic cleanup.
